Class InputParserFlight

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsw.view.InputParserFlight
public class InputParserFlight extends Object
InputParserFlight is responsible for interpreting and converting user-provided inputs into corresponding ClientEvent objects during the Flight phase of the game
